name: Little Pug 16
author: JkHuger
description: Gradient rounded light cyan button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translate(-.3em, -.3em), box-shadow becomes 14px 13px 0px -1px #BEE2F9, 14px 13px 0px 1px #000, border becomes 2px solid #000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Little Pug 16</title>
<style>
/* Little Pug 16 by JkHuger — https://uiverse.io/JkHuger/little-pug-16 */
.testbutton {
  display: block;
  font-family: helvetica;
  color: #000;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  box-shadow: 9px 8px 0px -1px#BEE2F9, 9px 8px 0px 1px #000;
  padding: 12px 25px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 2px solid #000;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, #63B8EE, #468CCF);
  transition: .3s;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.testbutton:hover {
  transition: .3s;
  transform: translate(-.3em, -.3em);
  box-shadow: 14px 13px 0px -1px #BEE2F9, 14px 13px 0px 1px #000;
  border: 2px solid #000;
}

.testbutton:active {
  transition: .3s;
  transform: translate(.6em, .6em);
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px -1px #BEE2F9, 0px 0px 0px 0.1px#000;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="testbutton">
  Click me
</button>

</body>
</html>
